messages.text: How much does it mine daily?

At 40 TH/s in a pool, the daily payout is small, and at 17.4 cents in Virginia Beach it generally lands under the roughly $2.68 a day the 40T costs to run. I won't dress that up with a number I can't stand behind.

Your exact daily sats figure is with the team and goes to (email hidden), they pick it up at 10am ET today.

The 40T is $799, Batch 6, ships November 21, 2026. Want me to hold a cart ready?

No problem. The numbers will be in your inbox when you want them.

One thing I'm curious about: you keep coming back to the daily figure. If it turned out the sats didn't cover the power, would that kill it for you, or would the block shot still be worth the $799?
